items.q: because I was his best man at his wedding, you know, when he married his first wife, Dorothy, you know.

ctx.x: And that neither one of you ever saw Levit. another thing.

No, we didn't. And this -- when her book came out I hadn't gotten anything else from it at that time. But, you know, it was -- I felt bad about it because, you know, if somebody do that to do and you don't know him, you don't feel so bad. But for a friend, you know, a guy that you consider a friend -- because I was his best man at his wedding, you know, when he married his first wife, Dorothy, you know.

In fact, when she died later -- years later, after all this problem happened, I went out -- myself and Louis Taylor, another trombone player, and we played a song with organ for -- at her funeral, you know. But you know, I couldn't hold it against her. She didn't do nothing to me, you know. But these things happen in this business, you know.
